solutions.title: Collect original nodes into two partitions
solutions.strategy: Place each original node reference into a less-than or greater-or-equal array, then relink those same nodes in stable order.

timeComplexity.explanation: The input is scanned once and every original node is appended once to the output chain.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The two temporary arrays store references to all n original nodes.

solutions.title: Two dummy chains
solutions.strategy: Append each original node to either a less-than chain or a greater-or-equal chain, then join both chains.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every node is visited once and appended to exactly one partition chain.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The algorithm reuses original nodes and stores only dummy/tail pointers.
